newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel to break down if 129.22 goes.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel to break down if 129.22 goes.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will trade sideways on Tuesday, bounded on the bottom by support at 129.22 and on the top around 129.64, technical analysts said.
A fall through 129.22 however, would send the contract cruising lower.
"Things are looking a bit weak," Jim Dodgin, senior technical analyst at Technical Data in London. "We're holding in above 129.46 but if we get below 129.30,22 then we could see quite a move lower."
June notionnel were quoted at 129.48 at 0736 GMT, down eight basis points on the day.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, also put support at 129.30,22, the lows from Monday and Friday respectively.

Dodgin said the contract would slide first to psychological support at 129.00 then 128.50 if those levels evaporated. Wood saw a slump down to around 128.60 at the outside, near the top of the previous range.
But Wood said the contract has performed stoically considering the recent EMU upsets.
"All these contracts have done well considering what they're up against," he said.
Dodgin said the notionnel needed to hurdle the area around 129.64, hourly lows from Monday to turn more bullish.

"Then things will look a bit more constructive but overall we'd look at best to be trading sideways," he said. "Yesterday we hit the top of the Bollinger band at 129.78 and that's likely to resist any move higher."
Bollinger bands are lines drawn at standard deviations around the price action to give support and resistance.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were quoted at 96.40, down 0.02 in the session.
